name: mindi-coat
description: Mindi Coat - Multiplayer Indian card game

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @mindi-coat/client" "npm run dev -w @mindi-coat/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mindi-coat/shared && npm run build -w @mindi-coat/server && npm run build -w @mindi-coat/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mindi-coat/shared && npm run test -w @mindi-coat/server && npm run test -w @mindi-coat/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @mindi-coat/client && npm run lint -w @mindi-coat/server
